user_query: I'm planning a surprise birthday party for my best friend, and I want to make it unique. Can you provide me with interesting trivia facts about the number 42? Also, suggest some fun trivia questions from different categories that I can include in the party games.

TaskList.description: Fetch interesting trivia facts about the number 42 to include in the party presentation.
Gather fun trivia questions from various categories (e.g., history, science, entertainment) for party games.
Compile and format the trivia facts and questions into a cohesive presentation for the party.
